subject.title: fix(share): preserve local rows during import

question: Should normal share imports remain exact snapshot replacement for existing users, or should this repository intentionally change the default to merge and retain local rows?
rationale: Both choices are plausible archive policies, but switching the default changes established caller behavior and cannot be resolved mechanically from the patch alone.

options.title: Keep replacement as default
options.body: Retain the current exact-replacement semantics for existing APIs and commands, and expose merge retention as an explicit option.

options.title: Approve merge as the new default
options.body: Accept the compatibility change only with maintainer-visible rationale, upgrade documentation, and focused coverage for existing replacement-dependent workflows.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement as default
recommendation.body: Retain the current exact-replacement semantics for existing APIs and commands, and expose merge retention as an explicit option.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only identified person directly connected to the proposed share-import contract change; repository-history ownership could not be confirmed.
